svg.aria-label: Architecture: browser signs in with Cognito, the chat UI calls an AgentCore Runtime with the user's JWT, the agent calls AgentCore Gateway with the same JWT, and the gateway checks Cedar policy before calling an MCP server or Lambda. Everything reports to CloudWatch.

g.text: Enterprise Agent Platform: one request, end to end
1 sign in · 2 user JWT to the agent · 3 same JWT to the gateway · 4 policy check, then the tool runs
JWT + group rule at the door
Request interceptor: stamps the real user
